settlements.name: Mav's Refuge
settlements.notes: Moved 2026-11-11 (the owner: onto a big river) from 1024,807 to the Beesh Baatar's valley floor (90 m3/s, 43 m wide, flowing E to W to the Ring Sea), -1,463 m, flat; 59.5 km from Girder.

settlements.name: Pinnacle Rock
settlements.notes: Beast Rider roost town on a red sandstone mesa (settlements/pinnacle-rock/PLAN.md). Moved 2026-10-18 from px 737,354 (approximate) to the knoll that clears the forest: 500-600 m over the jungle floor, the K'etsaal Baatar 11 km off. Moved 2026-11-10 (the owner: 'a spot not too far that's got a bit more forest') from 1027,681, which map 5.1 left in the NE rim's savanna, 41 km west to the savage hyperjungle's north-east edge: a knoll 110 m over its 14 km round (209 m prominence), -1,287 m, Aw, 1,490 mm, 77% of the ground within 9 km jungle; the Tsékooh Baatar 17 km off (openworld/PLAN-SITES.md, openworld/pinnacle).

settlements.name: Shade
settlements.notes: Moved 2026-11-11 (the owner: an oasis in the north, closer to Pinnacle Rock) from 1229,885 to the spring-head of the Wadi al-Bir al-Sharq trough, -406 m, BSh 549 mm, under a 2,400 m wet wall that feeds the aquifer; 156 km from Pinnacle Rock. No surface water on the model: the oasis and the plunge pool are the page's own (a towns water mask).

caverns.name: Entombed First Monastery Lava-Tube Vaults
caverns.notes: LORE.md 6.15: The original monastery of the Monks of History, buried under welded ignimbrite when the Lesser Throne erupted.
